title: 更从容地读英文
feynman_summary: Many learners can read part of an English article but lose confidence when the meaning starts to blur. A better reading tool keeps help close to the sentence, allowing the learner to stay inside the story instead of jumping between different tools. Guided by clear support, the reader can follow the main idea with less panic and more focus. When the reading flow feels steady rather than broken, deep reading becomes easier to continue and more likely to build real understanding.
chinese_translation: 许多学习者能读懂英文文章的一部分，但当意思开始变得模糊时就会失去信心。更好的阅读工具会把帮助放在句子附近，让学习者留在文章情境中，而不是在不同工具之间来回切换。在清晰支持的引导下，读者可以更少慌乱、更加专注地跟住文章主线。当阅读流程感觉稳定而不是被打断时，精读就更容易坚持，也更可能建立真正的理解。

sentences.text: Many learners can read part of an English article but lose confidence when the meaning starts to blur.
A better reading tool keeps help close to the sentence, allowing the learner to stay inside the story instead of jumping between different tools.
Guided by clear support, the reader can follow the main idea with less panic and more focus.
When the reading flow feels steady rather than broken, deep reading becomes easier to continue and more likely to build real understanding.

growth_vocabulary.context_meaning: 指文章意思开始不清楚、难以把握。
growth_vocabulary.memory_hook: 像照片失焦一样，意思一 blur，读者就抓不住内容了。

growth_vocabulary.context_meaning: 指读者在清晰支持下被带着往前读。
growth_vocabulary.memory_hook: 想象有人在旁边给你打手电，guided reading 就是不再摸黑读。

growth_vocabulary.context_meaning: 指阅读节奏平稳，没有频繁中断。
growth_vocabulary.memory_hook: steady 比 simply slow 更强调稳，不是慢，而是不乱。

growth_vocabulary.context_meaning: 指读者因为读不懂而产生的紧张感。
growth_vocabulary.memory_hook: 看到陌生句子先别 panic，文中说的是支持能把这种慌乱降下来。

growth_vocabulary.context_meaning: 指对整篇文章主线和意思的真正把握。
growth_vocabulary.memory_hook: build real understanding 是高频搭配，强调理解是逐步建立起来的。

high_frequency_phrases.usage_note: 可复用于表达保持在当前内容或语境里，不被外部因素打断。
阅读、听力和写作中都高频，可直接表达一段或一篇内容的核心意思。
是非常高复用的概率表达，适合写作中说明结果倾向。

language_evolution.rewritten_sentence: Guided by clear support, the reader can follow the main idea with less panic and more focus.
language_evolution.explanation: Guided by clear support 放在句首，说明主句动作发生时的条件或状态，相当于 Because the reader is guided by clear support。
language_evolution.imitation_example: Encouraged by her teacher, she kept reading even when the text became difficult.
